inventory.native_cache: Native evaluator already computes the medium pyramid once.
inventory.extra_cache: Medium modulation/gating and all target-time projections, once per trajectory.
inventory.timing: FP32 eager; batch 1; all per-trajectory cache preparation included; no CUDA Graph.

timing_definition.primary: Synchronized wall time, CPU-resident Vp/initial field to GPU-resident 101-field trajectory.
timing_definition.fd_included: Material/PML/wavelet construction, allocation, reset and FD updates 0..1000; store every tenth field.
timing_definition.mcwp_included: Input transfer, history/output allocation, medium encoding, all extra caching once, 100 recursive updates.
timing_definition.excluded: Disk I/O, checkpoint loading, warm-up, parity/accuracy checks, final CPU transfer.
timing_definition.initial_condition: MCWP is conditioned on supplied FD frame 0 and four zero older fields.
timing_definition.secondary: Primary plus a final transfer and owned CPU NumPy copy of all 101 fields.
timing_definition.stream_interval: Auxiliary event interval; includes GPU idle gaps and is not summed kernel execution time.
timing_definition.aggregation: Median across repeats per case, then group means, then equal weights for six groups.
